summary: NIP Group Inc., the registrant, filed a Form 6-K disclosing additional closing of the second tranche of its Bitcoin mining capacity acquisition. The initial closing on January 9, 2026 was settled with 167,917,734 Class A ordinary shares. On May 29, 2026, a second closing issued another 62,579,674 Class A ordinary shares to sellers/assignees, replacing previously contemplated convertible notes as consideration. The remaining closing is also expected to be settled in shares. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated. This is an equity-funded asset purchase; risk-arb focuses on dilution mechanics and completion timing.
